title: dynamic-batching-by-seqlen-bucketing-padding-heuristics-v10 - reduce padding and improve throughput
author: Priya Singh
description:
Motivation: reduce wasted compute from padding in continuous batching by grouping requests by sequence-length heuristics and adaptive bucketing. This PR iterates on the existing seqlen bucketing/padding minimization work (v1..v9) with three main goals: 1) improve end-to-end throughput on mixed-length workloads, 2) reduce per-token latency variance, and 3) keep KV cache locality predictable for long-running chat sessions.

Summary of changes: additive heuristic that combines fast approximate seqlen clustering with runtime cost model; deterministic bucketing pipeline that prefers smaller padding within latency SLO; a padding-aware scheduler that delays tiny requests briefly (configurable via max_delay_ms) to form better buckets; KV-cache affinity hints to avoid scattering cache entries across shards when bucket reassignment occurs; and a new micro-benchmark harness to measure padding overhead and batching efficiency.

Implementation details: - runtime/batching/dynamic_batcher.cpp/.h: new BucketManager that maintains histogram-based buckets and eviction policy; cost_model.h implements a lightweight cost estimator (compute cost + memory footprint) used by the scheduler. - runtime/scheduler/scheduler.cpp: integrated padding-aware scheduling hook and a soft-delay queue with backoff. - runtime/kv_cache/kv_affinity.cpp: KV cache hints emitted when a request is assigned to a bucket, preserving shard affinity across near-future requests. - serving/kernels/padding_optimizer.cpp: small kernel-level optimization to skip zeroed padding in the attention path when the padding ratio is below threshold. - tests/benchmarks/padding_bench.cc: new harness and repro workloads modeling web+chat mixed length distributions. - docs/ops/dynamic_batching.md: rollout guidance and tuning knobs.

Results: On internal mixed-length benchmark (web+chat, 70/30 split), we measured: median throughput +17%, p95 latency reduced by 12% for small requests, and average padding tokens dropped from 28% to 12% compared to v9 heuristics. KV-cache hit rate remained stable (+0.5% absolute) while stability of shard affinity reduced tail variance.

Testing and CI: unit tests added for bucket assignment, scheduler behavior, and KV affinity hints. Integration test that runs the padding_bench harness in CI is marked flaky on GPUs and is gated behind a retry; CI passed in final run after one retry (see ci_checks).

Rollout plan: merge to main behind a feature flag (runtime.dynamic_batching.v10). Start canary on dedicated pools for 48h with traffic shaping to emulate mixed-length distributions. If metrics (throughput, p95, padding_ratio) remain within targets, enable on more pools and remove flag after two weeks.

review_comments: Ethan Chen: Can you make the max_delay_ms configurable per pool? Small interactive workloads shouldn't introduce noticeable latency.
Priya Singh (reply): Added pool-level override and documented default 5ms. Updated docs/ops/dynamic_batching.md.
Ava Morgan: Kernel change looks safe but add a guard for non-contiguous padding layout (some upstream transformers use different padding tokens).
Priya Singh (reply): Added layout detection and fallback path + unit test.
Diego Ramirez: Need more telemetry around bucket churn and KV affinity misses before we enable on Dedicated. Can we emit the histograms?
Priya Singh (reply): Emitting bucket_churn_count and kv_affinity_miss_rate meters; added to per-route telemetry and Console dashboard proposal.
ci_checks: gpu-bench: flaky - reran once and pass
release_notes: Performance: Dynamic batching v10 improves mixed-length throughput by ~17% and reduces average padding tokens. Adds padding-aware scheduler and KV affinity hints. Rollout behind feature flag runtime.dynamic_batching.v10.
notes_for_ops: Feature is gated. Default max_delay_ms=5ms. Observe metrics: routing.batch.padding_ratio, routing.batch.bucket_churn_count, kv.affinity_miss_rate. Canary on dedicated pools for 48h before wide rollout.
bench_summary: Mixed workload (70% short web requests, 30% long chat): padding ratio 28% -> 12%, median throughput +17%, p95 latency small requests -12%.
changelog: Added BucketManager, padding-aware scheduler, kv affinity hints, kernel skip for padded tokens, and benchmark harness.
qa_notes: Integration test for padding_bench is flaky on GPU CI; local reproduce script included. Please validate on a staging dedicated pool with mixed-length traffic profile before approving rollback.
user_impact: No API changes. Behavior behind feature flag. Expected improvement in latency and cost for mixed-length workloads; very small risk of increased latency for ultra-low-latency single-request paths if max_delay_ms is misconfigured.
